exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: You ________ smoke in hospitals.
questions.explanation: 'Mustn't' is used for prohibition — smoking is not allowed in hospitals. 'Must' is for obligation. 'Don't have to' means it's not required. 'Mustn't' ကို ပိတ်ပင်ချက်တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: All employees ________ be on time for work.
questions.explanation: 'Must' is used for strong obligation — employees are required to be on time. 'Mustn't' is for prohibition. 'Don't have to' means it's not required. 'Must' ကို တာဝန်ဝတ်ရှိမှုတွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: The doctor ________ get here as soon as he can.
questions.explanation: 'Must' is used for strong obligation — it's urgent for the doctor to arrive. 'Mustn't' is for prohibition. 'Don't have to' means it's not required. 'Must' ကို အရေးပေါ်တာဝန်တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Bicyclists ________ remember to signal when they turn.
questions.explanation: 'Must' is used for important rules — cyclists are required to signal. 'Mustn't' is for prohibition. 'Don't have to' means it's not required. 'Must' ကို အရေးကြီးတဲ့ စည်းကမ်းတွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: Angela, you ________ leave your clothes all over the floor like this.

questions.question: Children ________ eat chewing gum.

questions.question: They ________ use their mobile phones during lessons.
